name: @lmctl-ai/n8n-lmcode
description: Independent n8n-style workflow runtime using LMScript and LMCode

scripts.build: mkdir -p build && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o build/lmflow-host ./cmd/lmflow-host
scripts.check: lmscript --check src/run.lms && lmscript --check tests/telegram-mock.lms && lmscript --check tests/validation-cases.lms && lmscript --check tests/runtime-cases.lms && lmscript --check tests/runtime-client.lms && lmscript --check test.lms
scripts.demo: npm run build && lmscript tests/telegram-mock.lms node node_modules/@lmctl-ai/lmctl/bin/lmscript src/run.lms examples/telegram.workflow.json connectors/telegram.json tests/fixtures/credentials.json
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
